test_title: PYST 72: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

Was the issue being handled by the legal team when the notice arrived?

options.text: Did the legal team handle the issue when the notice arrived?
Was the legal team handling the issue when the notice arrived?
Had the legal team handled the issue when the notice arrived?
Does the legal team handle the when the notice arrived?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is a passive voice question: "Was the issue being handled by the legal team when the notice arrived?"
 
• The sentence is in the **Past Continuous Tense** (Was/Were + being + V3).
 
• To convert from passive to active voice in the Past Continuous Tense: 
 
 
• Identify the agent (the doer), which is "the legal team."
 
• Place the agent after the auxiliary verb "was" (since "legal team" is a singular collective noun).
 
• Change the verb "being handled" to the active present participle form "handling."
 
• The receiver "the issue" becomes the direct object.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Was the legal team handling the issue when the notice arrived?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Did the legal team handle..." – Incorrect tense (Simple Past Active).
 
• **Option 3: **"Had the legal team handled..." – Incorrect tense (Past Perfect Active).
 
• **Option 4: **"Does the legal team handle..." – Incorrect tense (Simple Present Active) and the sentence is missing the object.
